en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3130 - It is narrated from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said: Salamah ibn Muhraz asked Abu Abdullah (as) while I was present.

He said: "I performed Tawaf around the Kaaba and between Safa and Marwah, then went to Mina and had relations with my wife without performing the Tawaf al-Nisa." Abu Abdullah (as) said: "What a bad thing you have done," reproaching me. I said: "I was put to trial." Imam (as) replied: "There is no penalty upon you."
